name: Mobile Release

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
    paths:
      - 'app/**'
      - 'lib/**'
      - 'config/**'
      - 'Gemfile*'
      - '.github/workflows/mobile-release.yml'

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:13
        env:
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
          POSTGRES_USER: postgres
          POSTGRES_DB: sure_test
        options: >-
          --health-cmd pg_isready
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
        ports:
          - 5432:5432

    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v3

    - name: Setup Ruby
      uses: ruby/setup-ruby@v1
      with:
        ruby-version: 3.0.4
        bundler-cache: true

    - name: Setup Node.js
      uses: actions/setup-node@v3
      with:
        node-version: '16'
        cache: 'yarn'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        sudo apt-get update
        sudo apt-get install -y libpq-dev
        yarn install --frozen-lockfile
        bundle install --jobs 4 --retry 3

    - name: Database setup
      run: |
        bin/rails db:create
        bin/rails db:schema:load
      env:
        RAILS_ENV: test
        DATABASE_URL: postgresql://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/sure_test

    - name: Run RuboCop
      run: bin/rubocop

    - name: Run tests
      run: |
        bin/rails test test/models/family_test.rb
        bin/rails test test/controllers/onboardings_controller_test.rb
      env:
        RAILS_ENV: test
        DATABASE_URL: postgresql://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/sure_test

    - name: Run migrations
      run: bin/rails db:migrate
      env:
        RAILS_ENV: test
        DATABASE_URL: postgresql://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/sure_test

  deploy:
    needs: test
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v3

    - name: Setup Ruby
      uses: ruby/setup-ruby@v1
      with:
        ruby-version: 3.0.4
        bundler-cache: true

    - name: Deploy to production
      run: |
        echo "Deploying to production..."
        # Add your deployment commands here
      env:
        DEPLOY_KEY: ${{ secrets.DEPLOY_KEY }}
        RAILS_ENV: production
